limits: Only fetched reachable Git objects; not server-unreachable/cached objects or external forks.
LFS payloads, submodules, encrypted/embedded binary content require follow-up.
Issues, PR discussion, Release text/assets, Actions logs/artifacts, wiki are separate surfaces.
Pattern detectors cannot establish that all prose, names, media or licensed content may be published.

limitations: Addresses were compared in memory only; raw email values were not saved.
This report covers current run metadata returned for the original collection cutoff. It does not claim old Actions metadata changes when Git history is rewritten.
Only currently returned REST objects and surviving downloads were collected; deleted objects, edited prior revisions, cached copies, inaccessible draft reviews and external forks are not enumerable.

Read-only GITHUB_TOKEN does not enumerate Draft Releases: GitHub requires push access for their listings. Verify the known Draft notes/assets separately through existing authorized access and validated Release candidate hashes; do not expand this job to write permissions.
Expired, removed, unavailable and size-limited historical objects are explicit gaps, not successful scans.
Current/in-progress runs at the cutoff are explicit temporal exclusions; review their completed logs and new Release/assets separately before any public decision.
Issue/PR attachments and arbitrary links were inventoried as candidates, never followed.
Binary string extraction is not OCR, visual review, malware analysis, or verification of media licensing and publication rights.
Workflow and artifact collections can change concurrently; API totals, duplicate IDs and reviewed main are checked, but the API offers no atomic snapshot.
Repository settings, collaborators, encrypted Actions secret values, security alerts, Discussions, wiki and external services need separately authorized/available checks.
A clean pattern scan is evidence for human review; it does not authorize visibility changes or prove all prose and media may be published.

surface_audit.conclusion_reason: 10 detector candidates retained, subsequently reviewed as exact file checksums

release_source_assets.limitation: Historical source archive members were correlated through tag, exact member byte size, and unique matching Git tree file, rather than downloaded a second time for binary hash equality.

logs.evidence: surface_audit.email_log_job_inventory and email_unmatched_archive_sources in this document

privacy_dispositions.credential_in_url_disposition: Three negative provider URL fixture occurrences in historical source archives; see release_source_assets proof.

binary_candidates.limitation: One flagged PNG was inspected directly; the count includes repeated CI media. No claim of per-image OCR, visual privacy review, or licensing verification for all 2860 records.

limits: Draft Releases require separate review through existing authorized access; read-only runner token cannot list them.
No embedded GitHub attachment links were flagged by the collector's specific pattern. Arbitrary URLs were not followed.
Deleted objects and prior edited text versions cannot be claimed covered.
Historical Actions head_commit metadata retains the personal email independently of rewriting current Git refs.
No public visibility or Release publish action was performed by this audit.

limitations: Human review of retrieved evidence is not a proof that all historical deleted/cached/external data can be enumerated.
Binary string extraction is not full OCR, malware analysis or intellectual-property proof.
This one-time branch audit has not installed recurring secret scanning on main.
No repository visibility change, formal Release publication, history rewrite, tag movement or historical asset deletion was performed.

history_binary_review.findings: No private information or credential findings identified in the six binary blobs.

verification.git_blob_sha1: All six verified against actual bytes and Git blob framing.
verification.catalogue_po_match: All four catalogs exactly equal corresponding version of tracked source .po, including metadata.
verification.catalogue_metadata: Last-Translator, Language-Team, Report-Msgid-Bugs-To are blank in all four.
verification.catalogue_structure: All bytes accounted for by the GNU MO header, offset tables, and strings. No extra bytes.
verification.manual_catalogue_review: 295 distinct source message keys and 282 distinct Japanese translations across all four historical catalogs reviewed; block editor UI text only.
verification.png_structure: All chunk CRCs verified. IHDR/sRGB/eXIf/IDAT/IEND only; no text chunks, no trailing data.
verification.png_metadata: Only sRGB plus EXIF ColorSpace=1 and image dimensions; no author, device, GPS, or timestamps.
verification.png_visual: Both show dummy animewp verification site with generic placeholder art/text. No private individuals, credentials, URLs, or admin/browser UI observed.

history_binary_review.scope: All six binary object IDs supplied by root mapped and inspected. GitHub default-main path histories return 2 screenshot revisions and 4 MO revisions. Representative immutable commit/tag refs verified; did not exhaustively enumerate alternate paths across all 52 historical commits. Authorship beyond repository copyright declarations not independently proven.
